criteria.commensurate: Yes in proportion. +0.8 s web, +18.9 pct, on one seed of one leg (20 households seed 47, 3.7 -> 4.4 s), while the reference total fell 20.6 -> 13.4 s (-35 pct) and every other leg fell 5-67 pct. The gain is a grown cluster with routed door paths, replacing the front-row, rank, rescue and exhaustive passes (research R10: homesteads 101.4 -> 84.8 s at 40 households). Proportion is not what fails.
criteria.necessary: Partly. Growing the nucleated cluster (D1, FR-007, growth.py) and routing a grown house path (D3, FR-005, route.py) are spec work the GM asked for. Re-joining the routed pieces the lane law cuts (_join_orphan_ways, ~0.37 s on seed 47 at 20 households) is the necessary cost of D3. The growth half is not: about 0.15-0.2 s of it is short_fragments rebuilding the same WorkedGround (shapely unary_union of the fields, dry plots and rice) for every candidate. The without manifest differs only in lanes, so that work is redundant.
criteria.no_way_around: Fails for part of it: a cheaper way exists and was measured. law.short_fragments calls dangling_lane_ends(M) and dangling_lane_ends(without) without the ground argument it already accepts, so each call rebuilds WorkedGround. Building it once and passing it (reviewer worktree off 298403d31, three-line change) cut WorkedGround builds 7 -> 4, short_fragments 0.24-0.29 -> 0.11 s and web 1.31-1.38 -> 1.13-1.14 s on seed 47 at 20 households (two alternated runs, load 9-12). The manifest is byte-identical (lanes, houses, access_corridors hash 14ac41c871 both). The 4 remaining builds (0.17 s, against 2 at start) are other callers that could share the same memo_ground. Per dev/performance.md this is the per-candidate rebuild of unchanging geometry that every slow generator here has had. Fix it in this work (XIV), then re-measure. Not shown either way: whether routed corridors could be pre-cut to the lane law so the web need not re-join them.

note: Band 2: 20 households seed 47 +18.9 pct (web 0.39 -> 1.2 s). Reviewer counterfactual: routing forced off at 298403d31 puts web at 0.77-0.83 s, so D3 accounts for ~0.37 s and the grown layout for ~0.4 s. The first hand-off was inconsistent (confirmation 20261002T140731Z).
